API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIForwarding GatewaysEc Gateway Z Resource Edit Gateway
Ec Gateway Z Resource Edit Gateway
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/gateways/:gatewayId

Updates the ZIA gateway or log and control gateway based on the specified gateway ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
gatewayId
int32
REQUIRED

The ID of the gateway.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
id
int32

ID of the gateway.

name
string

Name of the gateway.

type
string

Type of the gateway. Supported types are ZIA and ECSELF (Log and Control gateway).

Possible values: [PROXYCHAIN, ZIA, ECSELF]

description
string

Description of the gateway.

lastModifiedBy
object
lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the gateway was last modified.

failClosed
boolean

A true value indicates that traffic must be dropped when both primary and secondary proxies defined in the gateway are unreachable. A false value indicates that traffic must be allowed.

manualPrimary
string

Specifies the primary proxy through which traffic must be forwarded. Depending on the type of proxy forwarding, this field includes a preconfigured data center, or a specified IP address or domain name.

manualSecondary
string

Specifies the secondary proxy through which traffic must be forwarded. Depending on the type of proxy forwarding, this field includes a preconfigured data center, or a specified IP address or domain name.

subcloudPrimary
object
subcloudSecondary
object
primaryType
string

Type of the primary proxy, such as automatic proxy (AUTO), manual proxy (DC) that forwards traffic through selected data centers, or override (MANUAL_OVERRIDE) that forwards traffic through a specified IP address or domain.

Possible values: [NONE, AUTO, MANUAL_OVERRIDE, SUBCLOUD, VZEN, PZEN, DC]

secondaryType
string

Type of the secondary proxy, such as automatic proxy (AUTO), manual proxy (DC) that forwards traffic through selected data centers, or override (MANUAL_OVERRIDE) that forwards traffic through a specified IP address or domain.

Possible values: [NONE, AUTO, MANUAL_OVERRIDE, SUBCLOUD, VZEN, PZEN, DC]

Responses
​
default

default response

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
